sections.title: Mass spectrometer and mass spectra

paras.text: … trajectory, causing them to adopt a circular path, the radius of which depends on their mass-to-charge ratio (m/z). Ions of small m/z values are deflected more than those of larger m/z. By varying the magnetic field strength, ions of a particular m/z can be selectively focused through a narrow slit onto a detector, where they are counted. A mass spectrum is the graph plotted by the mass spectrometer, with the m/z values on x-axis and the relative number of ions of each mass on the y-axis. Higher the peak of a species higher will be its abundance.
paras.urdu: … راستے سے موڑ کر دائری راستہ اختیار کرنے پر مجبور کرتا ہے جس کا رداس ان کی کمیت اور چارج کی نسبت (m/z) پر منحصر ہے۔ کم m/z والے آئن زیادہ m/z والوں سے زیادہ مڑتے ہیں۔ مقناطیسی میدان کی طاقت بدل کر کسی خاص m/z کے آئنز کو منتخب طور پر تنگ شگاف سے ڈیٹیکٹر پر مرکوز کیا جا سکتا ہے جہاں انہیں گنا جاتا ہے۔ ماس طیف ماس سپیکٹرومیٹر کا بنایا ہوا گراف ہے جس میں x-محور پر m/z اقدار اور y-محور پر ہر کمیت کے آئنز کی نسبتی تعداد ہوتی ہے۔ کسی نوع کی چوٹی جتنی اونچی ہو اس کی کثرت اتنی زیادہ ہوگی۔
paras.pashto: … لارې څخه اړوي او دایروي لاره غوره کولو ته یې اړ باسي چې شعاع یې د دوی د کتلې او چارج په نسبت (m/z) پورې اړه لري. د کوچني m/z ایونونه د لوی m/z په پرتله ډېر کږېږي. د مقناطیسي ساحې د قوت په بدلولو د یوه ځانګړي m/z ایونونه په ټاکلي ډول له یوه نري درز څخه پر موندونکي متمرکز کېدای شي چې هلته شمېرل کېږي. ماس طیف د ماس سپکټرومیټر له خوا رسم شوی ګراف دی چې د x-محور پر m/z ارزښتونه او د y-محور پر د هرې کتلې د ایونونو نسبي شمېر لري. د یوه ډول څوکه څومره لوړه وي، کثرت به یې هومره زیات وي.

paras.text: Mass spectrum helps in finding the number of isotopes of an element and also their relative abundances. The mass spectrum of neon shows three peaks with m/z equal to 20, 21, and 22 which correspond to ²⁰Ne, ²¹Ne and ²²Ne respectively. Neon–20 is the most abundant and Neon–21 is the least abundant isotope as clear from the heights of their peaks.
paras.urdu: ماس طیف کسی عنصر کے آئسوٹوپس کی تعداد اور ان کی نسبتی کثرت معلوم کرنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ نیون کا ماس طیف m/z کے 20، 21 اور 22 کے برابر تین چوٹیاں دکھاتا ہے جو بالترتیب ²⁰Ne، ²¹Ne اور ²²Ne کے مطابق ہیں۔ چوٹیوں کی اونچائی سے واضح ہے کہ نیون–20 سب سے زیادہ اور نیون–21 سب سے کم پایا جانے والا آئسوٹوپ ہے۔
paras.pashto: ماس طیف د یوه عنصر د ایزوټوپونو شمېر او د هغوی نسبي کثرت په موندلو کې مرسته کوي. د نیون ماس طیف درې څوکې ښيي چې m/z یې 20، 21 او 22 دي او په ترتیب سره له ²⁰Ne، ²¹Ne او ²²Ne سره سمون لري. د څوکو له لوړوالي څرګندېږي چې نیون–20 تر ټولو ډېر او نیون–21 تر ټولو لږ موندل کېدونکی ایزوټوپ دی.

paras.text: When a molecule is introduced into mass spectrometer, the molecular ion (M⁺) is produced due to loss of an electron. The molecular ion has the highest m/z value that represents the molecular mass of molecule. In addition to the molecular ion, more ions are produced due to fragmentation of the molecule. Fragmentation occurs due to rupture of chemical bonds. A mass spectrum of chlorine molecule is given in Figure 24.15 shows that there are two isotopes of chlorine ³⁵Cl (m/z = 35) and ³⁷Cl (m/z = 37) and three types of chlorine molecules, ³⁵Cl–³⁵Cl (m/z = 70), ³⁵Cl–³⁷Cl (m/z = 72) and ³⁷Cl–³⁷Cl (m/z = 74).

… trajectory, causing them to adopt a circular path, the radius of which depends on their mass-to-charge ratio (m/z). Ions of small m/z values are deflected more than those of larger m/z. By varying the magnetic field strength, ions of a particular m/z can be selectively focused through a narrow slit onto a detector, where they are counted. A mass spectrum is the graph plotted by the mass spectrometer, with the m/z values on x-axis and the relative number of ions of each mass on the y-axis. Higher the peak of a species higher will be its abundance.

Figure 24.13 Schematic diagram of a Mass Spectrometer.

Mass spectrum helps in finding the number of isotopes of an element and also their relative abundances. The mass spectrum of neon shows three peaks with m/z equal to 20, 21, and 22 which correspond to ²⁰Ne, ²¹Ne and ²²Ne respectively. Neon–20 is the most abundant and Neon–21 is the least abundant isotope as clear from the heights of their peaks.

Figure 24.14 Mass spectrum of Neon.

When a molecule is introduced into mass spectrometer, the molecular ion (M⁺) is produced due to loss of an electron. The molecular ion has the highest m/z value that represents the molecular mass of molecule. In addition to the molecular ion, more ions are produced due to fragmentation of the molecule. Fragmentation occurs due to rupture of chemical bonds. A mass spectrum of chlorine molecule is given in Figure 24.15 shows that there are two isotopes of chlorine ³⁵Cl (m/z = 35) and ³⁷Cl (m/z = 37) and three types of chlorine molecules, ³⁵Cl–³⁵Cl (m/z = 70), ³⁵Cl–³⁷Cl (m/z = 72) and ³⁷Cl–³⁷Cl (m/z = 74).

Figure 24.15 Mass spectrum of chlorine (Cl₂).

The fragmentation pattern of a molecule gives an idea of the structure of the molecule. Thus mass spectrometry is very helpful in the identification of molecular structures as well. Mass spectrum of methyl alcohol is given in Figure 24.16.

Figure 24.16 Mass Spectrum of methyl alcohol.
